result.description: Cloud CRM for sales: leads, contacts, deals, accounts, pipelines and automation, with a REST API and extensible modules.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 only. Register a client in the Zoho API Console (server-based, client-based, mobile, non-browser or Self Client) to get a Client ID and secret. Access tokens last 1 hour. Refresh tokens last until revoked. Each customer org authorizes the app itself, and data-center-specific domains apply.
result.access_detail: Anyone can register an OAuth client in the Zoho API Console with no review. The docs I fetched say nothing about Marketplace listing or app review for other orgs to connect, and no such gate was found. That is an absence of evidence, not a confirmed negative. API access is not paid-only: the Free edition gets 5000 API credits and 5 concurrent calls, and higher editions get more. Free tier caps are low but usable. Not checked: the pricing page, the OAuth web-server-applications page, and whether Free edition API access has been narrowed since. Self-serve is therefore medium confidence.
result.api_notes: API v8 has Metadata, Core (CRUD on all modules), Composite (up to 5 calls per request), Bulk, Notification (webhooks) and Query (COQL, SQL-like SELECT) APIs. Each API call costs 1 credit, with per-edition daily credit and concurrency limits.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
To access the resources of Zoho using the various Zoho APIs, you will need to register your application with Zoho first.
On successful registration of your application, you will get a Client ID and Client secret.
Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
MCP integrates with many Zoho apps, including CRM, Mail, Calendar, Desk, Cliq, Projects, and WorkDrive.
